verdict.rationale: Neon's engine is open source and can be compiled and run on a workstation for small experiments and to test code changes, so a local, account-free path exists. The evidence frames this as building from source rather than a packaged offline-dev or CI workflow. The 'Neon Local' doc appears only as a bare title with no content showing it works without the cloud. Missing for 10: a packaged or prebuilt local runtime (e.g. a documented container image), documented CI-test usage, an explicit no-account/offline guarantee, parity confirmation with the hosted service, and hands-on corroboration.
